package v1

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
)

// RegisterRoutes registers student routes and their explicit role policy.
func RegisterRoutes(router chi.Router, personalTeacher *handlers.PersonalTeacherHandler, teacherDialog *handlers.TeacherDialogHandler, curriculum *handlers.CurriculumHandler, learningSession *handlers.LearningSessionHandler, telegram *handlers.TelegramChannelHandler, onboarding *handlers.TeacherOnboardingHandler, nextBestAction *handlers.NextBestActionHandler) {
	student := middleware.RequireRole("STUDENT", "STUDENT_PRO")
	router.With(student).Get("/teacher/me", personalTeacher.GetMe)
	router.With(student).Patch("/teacher/me", personalTeacher.UpdateMe)
	router.With(student).Get("/teacher/me/soul", personalTeacher.GetMySoul)
	router.With(student).Patch("/teacher/me/soul", personalTeacher.UpdateMySoul)
	router.With(student).Put("/teacher-dialog/ensure", teacherDialog.Ensure)
	if curriculum != nil {
		router.With(student).Post("/teacher/me/diagnostic-assessments/complete", curriculum.CompleteDiagnostic)
		router.With(student).Post("/teacher/me/learning-path/plan", curriculum.Plan)
	}
	if learningSession != nil {
		router.With(student).Post("/teacher/me/learning-sessions/{sessionID}/summarize", learningSession.Summarize)
	}
	if telegram != nil {
		router.With(student).Post("/teacher/me/channels/telegram/link-code", telegram.IssueLinkCode)
	}
	if onboarding != nil {
		router.With(student).Post("/teacher/me/onboarding/ensure", onboarding.Ensure)
		router.With(student).Post("/teacher/me/assistant-ui/actions", onboarding.ApplyAction)
	}
	if nextBestAction != nil {
		router.With(student).Get("/teacher/me/next-action", nextBestAction.Get)
	}
}

// NewRouter builds a student router without composing gateway authentication.
func NewRouter(personalTeacher *handlers.PersonalTeacherHandler, teacherDialog *handlers.TeacherDialogHandler, curriculum *handlers.CurriculumHandler, learningSession *handlers.LearningSessionHandler, telegram *handlers.TelegramChannelHandler, onboarding *handlers.TeacherOnboardingHandler, nextBestAction *handlers.NextBestActionHandler) chi.Router {
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	RegisterRoutes(router, personalTeacher, teacherDialog, curriculum, learningSession, telegram, onboarding, nextBestAction)
	return router
}
